description: Co-branded ecosystem card with PhonePe on the RuPay network offering up to 10% reward points on PhonePe app utility/recharge/travel spends, 5% on top online brands, and domestic airport lounge access.
feeWaiver: Waived on annual retail spends of ₹3,00,000 in preceding year.
rewardSummary: Up to 10% reward points on PhonePe app spends (mobile recharge, electricity, broadband, insurance, flight/hotel bookings); up to 5% on top online brands; 1% on Scan & Pay and other retail.
rewardCaps: 10% category points capped at 2,000 reward points per statement cycle.
exclusions: Fuel, wallet loads, rent, government transactions, cash advances.
benefits: ₹1,500 worth PhonePe vouchers or gift points on card activation
Up to 10% reward return on all bills, recharges, and bookings inside PhonePe
Seamless linking to PhonePe for UPI Scan & Pay across all merchants
4 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits per year (1 per quarter)
Complimentary 2-year Priority Pass membership for international travelers
incomeRequirement: ₹35,000/month for salaried; ITR > ₹6 Lakhs for self-employed
locationRestrictions: Pan India (apply directly in PhonePe App).
travelBenefits: 4 domestic airport lounge visits + Priority Pass membership.
loungeBenefits: 4 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits per calendar year.
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹250 per statement cycle.
diningBenefits: Standard SBI Card dining tie-ups.
milestoneBenefits: Travel voucher worth ₹5,00,0 on reaching annual spend of ₹5,00,000.
officialSource: SBI Card & PhonePe Official Partnership Page
goodFor: Households managing multiple utility bills, recharges, and UPI QR payments
whoItFits: Individuals who use PhonePe as their primary app for electricity bills, mobile recharges, insurance, and local merchant UPI payments.
whatToWatchOutFor: Maximum 10% rewards are realized when transactions are routed inside the PhonePe ecosystem.
whyCreditWiseRecommends: Unlike most cards that completely exclude electricity and utility bills from rewards, this card rewards them at up to 10%.

name: BOBCARD Scapia Credit Card
shortDescription: Zero forex markup travel card with unlimited domestic lounge access and zero annual fee.
description: Co-branded travel card issued by BOBCARD in partnership with Scapia, featuring zero foreign exchange fees worldwide, 10% Scapia Coins on everyday spends, and unlimited airport lounge visits on meeting monthly spend.
feeWaiver: Lifetime Free with zero joining fee and zero annual maintenance fee.
rewardSummary: 10% Scapia Coins on all eligible online and offline retail spending (2% value back); 20% Scapia Coins on travel bookings made via the Scapia app (4% value back); 5 Scapia Coins = ₹1.
rewardCaps: No maximum cap on Scapia Coins earned.
exclusions: Fuel, wallet top-ups, rent, education, government services, cash advances.
benefits: 100% Lifetime Free credit card with no joining or renewal charges
Zero forex markup on all international transactions worldwide (saving 3.5% to 4%)
Unlimited domestic airport lounge access upon spending ₹20,000 in previous billing cycle
Coins redeemable instantly with 1-click on flights and hotels in Scapia app
Instant in-app customer service and virtual card activation
eligibility: Indian resident aged 23-60 years with good credit history.
travelBenefits: Zero forex markup fee worldwide, unlimited domestic lounge access, and 20% coins on flight/hotel bookings.
loungeBenefits: Unlimited domestic airport lounge visits (unlocked by spending ₹20,000 in preceding billing cycle).
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹250 per billing cycle.
diningBenefits: 10% Scapia Coins on all dining and food delivery spends.
forexBenefits: 0.0% zero foreign currency transaction markup fee.
milestoneBenefits: None (zero-annual-fee continuous rewards structure).
goodFor: International holidaymakers, foreign study expenses, and frequent domestic flyers
whoItFits: Anyone traveling abroad or making foreign currency online payments who wants to eliminate the 3.5% bank forex penalty.
whatToWatchOutFor: Lounge access requires spending ₹20,000 in the previous statement cycle; Scapia Coins can only be redeemed on flights and hotels in the Scapia app.
whyCreditWiseRecommends: Completely lifetime free with 0% forex markup, saving travelers thousands of rupees on international hotel and flight bookings.
